description: This file implements the HostMappingRules class, which manages hostname mapping and exclusion rules, including functions to rewrite host URLs based on pattern matching rules.

classes.name: HostMappingRules::MapRule
classes.description: Represents a hostname pattern and its replacement hostname and port for mapping rules.

classes.name: HostMappingRules::ExclusionRule
classes.description: Represents a hostname pattern for exclusion rules.

methods.name: HostMappingRules::RewriteHost
methods.description: Rewrites the host and port of a given HostPortPair based on matching rules.

methods.name: HostMappingRules::RewriteUrl
methods.description: Rewrites the URL's host and port if a matching rule exists.

methods.name: HostMappingRules::AddRuleFromString
methods.description: Adds a hostname mapping or exclusion rule from a string description.

methods.name: HostMappingRules::SetRulesFromString
methods.description: Sets multiple rules from a comma-separated string of rule descriptions.
